assumptions: Deviations are modelled as a Poisson process — independent arrivals at a constant average rate. Real deviations cluster (one site problem causes several), so this understates how lumpy the real thing is.

The rate is estimated from the last 4 cut(s) (cuts 3-6, counts [4, 7, 11, 4]), giving 6.50 new deviations per cut. Cuts with no deviations are counted as zero, not skipped. Only deviations first seen at each cut are counted, not the running total.
